user.title: NIBE F750 Smart Control
user.description: Use your existing myUplink entities and automatically install both dashboard cards. Control starts as soon as valid readings are available. Existing write timestamps still limit repeated requests. Disable the old thermostat/DHW automations. If migrating, remove the old nibe_f750_trial.yaml package and restart HA first.

abort.already_configured: Only one controller can be configured.

error.myuplink_required: Set up Home Assistant’s built-in myUplink integration first.

yaml_resource.title: Add the NIBE card module to YAML dashboard resources
yaml_resource.description: Your dashboard resources use YAML mode. Add /nibe-f750/nibe-f750-card.js as a module resource and remove the previous NIBE card resources. Storage-mode dashboards are configured automatically.

init.title: Adaptive control settings
init.description: Learning and predictive control run automatically. Set comfort bounds and optional hourly weather entity. Heat-loss/storage/capacity values are starting estimates; existing learning is retained. Use Reset NIBE learning on the integration device to restart from those estimates.

abort.invalid_bounds: Minimum, target and maximum temperatures must be in that order.
